title: Filters
summary: Footage treatments shown on the sample clip: a gentle grade as the base look, frame devices (inset card, tall panels), soft fast cuts and light effects, with the theme's cyan, magenta and highlighter where an effect adds colour. The room is never dimmed in this style, so keep looks light.
usage: In a footage storyboard: {"footage": {"look": {"name": "film_grade", "amount": 0.8}}}, {"name": "inset_frame", "at": 2.4, "seconds": 1.6, "amount": 1, "where": "all"} and, on a cut, {"name": "push_blur", "at": 5.2, "seconds": 0.25, "amount": 0.8, "where": "in"}. Effects apply to the finished picture, so captions travel with the card. On a shot candidate: {"effect": {"name": "white_dip", "amount": 0.7, "where": "in"}}. Theme effects: library/themes/psychedelic/effects/theme_effects.py; engine: library/_shared/effects_engine.py (OpenCV).

items.name: film grade
items.description: The theme base look: gentle film. Soft contrast, slightly lifted blacks, warm highlights, natural colour, fine grain. Use around 0.8 as the footage look.

items.name: noir
items.description: Editorial black and white: soft silver greys, deep but not crushed blacks, darker corners, fine grain.

items.name: soft vignette
items.description: Darker, slightly softer corners that pull the eye to the middle.

items.name: soft focus
items.description: The whole picture slips out of focus and dims a little, so a word can sit on it.

items.name: inset frame
items.description: THE frame device: the shot as a clean, sharp card over a blurred, enlarged, dimmed copy of itself. Pulls back at the start of its time and returns to full frame at the end.

items.name: inset hold
items.description: The same card with no movement of its own: amount is how far it has pulled back ("where": "in" starts on the card and opens to full frame; "out" closes down to it).

items.name: triptych
items.description: The shot as three tall panels: the middle one untouched, the narrow outer two pushed in and slipped up and down. Opens and closes with its time.

items.name: panel drop
items.description: The picture arrives as tall panels of unequal width sliding in from above and below, then closes up. Use "where": "in" on a cut.

items.name: push blur
items.description: A soft zoom-blur push for cuts and punch-ins.

items.name: whip smear
items.description: A sideways whip: the picture smears and slides as if the camera snapped across.

items.name: chroma burst
items.description: The loud one: the picture’s own colours pushed to saturated primaries and stretched into radial streaks, channels split. Once or twice a video.

items.name: white dip
items.description: A soft dip to white: highlights bloom and the picture washes out, rather than flashing.

items.name: light sweep
items.description: A band of warm light travelling across the frame over its time, with a cool trailing edge.

items.name: halation
items.description: Shared engine: a red-orange glow around the brightest highlights, like film stock.

items.name: grain
items.description: Shared engine: plain film grain.

items.name: punch hit
items.description: A zoom hit for jump cuts: the picture pops to about 1.08x with a short radial blur. Use "where": "in", 0.15–0.25 s.

items.name: speed smear
items.description: Speed-ramp feel: every row dragged into long horizontal streaks, highlights longest. No slide.

items.name: flash frame
items.description: An impact frame: the picture in three tones — ink blacks, highlighter mids, white highlights. Two to four frames at a hit; sparingly.

items.name: shutter blink
items.description: A camera shutter: soft-edged deep navy blades close from top and bottom by the amount. Use "pulse".

items.name: strobe step
items.description: A jump-in stutter: the picture steps in three hard stages up to 1.08x across its time. Use "where": "all" over 0.3–0.5 s.

items.name: tilt snap
items.description: A quick roll of up to 2.5 degrees with a slight push-in that snaps back level. Use "where": "in".

items.name: siren wash
items.description: Emergency lights in the theme’s colours: highlighter from the left and cyan from the right alternating three times a second, screened softly over the picture.

items.name: moody grade
items.description: A low-key look: darker, less colour, cool teal-blue shadows under slightly warm highlights, heavy soft corners, fine grain.

items.name: spotlight
items.description: A warm pool of light from above on the person; the room falls away to deep navy. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: rim light
items.description: Dark, cool scene; a thin bright outline traces the person. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: flashlight
items.description: A hard round beam on the face that drifts a little; everything else dark. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: golden hour
items.description: Low warm sun with leaf shadows dappled across the scene. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: neon
items.description: Hot magenta from one side, a cyan touch from the other, dark in between. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: projector
items.description: A bright lamp flaring behind the head through haze, teal room. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: under light
items.description: Light from below: the campfire or horror look. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: low key
items.description: Mostly shadow: one small key on the face, deep blacks. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: silhouette
items.description: Bright hazy background, the person a dark shape with a faint edge. Finds the person in each frame; use 0.6–1 over a whole clip or a section.

items.name: cop lights
items.description: The room drops dark and red and blue police lights strobe across the person from both sides. Options ("props"): color, color2 (hex), speed (flashes per second, 2.2), push (1.08).

items.name: colour grade
items.description: The look changes on a word: moody, warm, cool, black and white or pop fades in (or ripples out from a point). Options ("props"): grade (moody, warm, cool, bw, pop), style (fade or ripple), dur (seconds to arrive), x, y (ripple origin, 0–1). Also works as a footage "look".
